## Expansion Calculations
```{r}
## TCR Recalculation
Tc_TCR <- subset(Tc, Frequency > 0)


Tc_TCR$Exp <- "Exp"
Tc_TCR <- recalculateFrequency(Tc_TCR, cloneCall = "gene", groupBy = "PID")

Tc_TCR$Frequency <- Tc_TCR$recalFrequency.PID

slot(Tc_TCR, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(Tc_TCR, "meta.data")$cloneType, levels = c(
"Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)",
"Large (0.01 < X <= 0.1)",
"Medium (0.001 < X <= 0.01)",
"Small (1e-04 < X <= 0.001)",
"Rare (0 < X <= 1e-04)",
"Single Clone", NA))

Tc_TCR$cloneSize <- Tc_TCR $cloneType

table(Tc_TCR$cloneSize)

levels(factor(Tc_TCR$recalFrequency.PID))

## Assign Expanded vs Non-Expanded Label
Tc_TCR$Expanded <- Tc_TCR$Frequency
Idents(Tc_TCR) <- "Expanded"

Tc_TCR$Expanded <- ifelse(Tc_TCR$recalFrequency.PID == "Single", "Single", "Expanded")
Tc_TCR$Expanded <- Tc_TCR$Expanded
table(Tc_TCR$Expanded)
```

#-----Human T Cell Expansion an Diversity Metrics-----
## Plaque % Expansion
```{r}
Enrichment <- data.frame(
  Expanded = Tc_TCR$Expanded,
  Tissue   = Tc_TCR$PB,
  Patient  = Tc_TCR$PID
) %>%
  group_by(Patient, Tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    Expanded = sum(Expanded == "Expanded", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_Expanded = 100 * Expanded / total,
    Patient_Group = paste(Patient, Tissue)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(Enrichment, file = "../docs/assets/02-Figure-2/PB_Enrichement_Percentages.csv")
```

#----Gene Concordance---- {.tabset .tabset-pills}
```{r}
## ---- CD4/CD8 vs Unstable directionality in one chunk ----
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

sig_thresh <- 0.05

## 1) CD8 plaque: Expanded vs Single
Idents(p8_TCR) <- "Expanded"

CD8_DEG_comp <- FindMarkers(
  p8_TCR,
  min.pct        = 0.2,
  ident.1        = "Expanded",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  test.use       = "MAST",
  only.pos       = FALSE
)
CD8_DEG_comp$gene <- rownames(CD8_DEG_comp)

## 2) CD4 plaque: Expanded vs Single
p4_TCR <- subset(Tc4_TCR, PB == "Plaque")
Idents(p4_TCR) <- "Expanded"

CD4_DEG_comp <- FindMarkers(
  p4_TCR,
  min.pct        = 0.2,
  ident.1        = "Expanded",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  test.use       = "MAST",
  only.pos       = FALSE
)
CD4_DEG_comp$gene <- rownames(CD4_DEG_comp)

## 3) Unstable vs Stable plaque
Idents(Tc_TCR) <- "PB"
test <- subset(Tc_TCR, PB == "Plaque")

Idents(test) <- "Tissue"
Unstable_DEG_comp <- FindMarkers(
  test,
  min.pct        = 0.2,
  ident.1        = "Unstable",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  test.use       = "MAST",
  only.pos       = FALSE
)
Unstable_DEG_comp$gene <- rownames(Unstable_DEG_comp)
```


```{r}
## 4) Ensure gene column exists (safety)
if (!"gene" %in% colnames(CD8_DEG_comp)) {
  CD8_DEG_comp <- CD8_DEG_comp %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
}
if (!"gene" %in% colnames(Unstable_DEG_comp)) {
  Unstable_DEG_comp <- Unstable_DEG_comp %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
}
if (!"gene" %in% colnames(CD4_DEG_comp)) {
  CD4_DEG_comp <- CD4_DEG_comp %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
}

## 5) Gene universe: significant in CD8 OR Unstable (your original behaviour)
sig_genes <- union(
  CD8_DEG_comp      %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < sig_thresh) %>% pull(gene),
  Unstable_DEG_comp %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < sig_thresh) %>% pull(gene)
)

## 6) Merge CD8 + Unstable (as before), then join CD4
merged_sig <- full_join(
  CD8_DEG_comp %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj) %>%
    rename(CD8_logFC = avg_log2FC, CD8_padj = p_val_adj),
  Unstable_DEG_comp %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj) %>%
    rename(Unstable_logFC = avg_log2FC, Unstable_padj = p_val_adj),
  by = "gene"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% sig_genes) %>%
  mutate(
    CD8_logFC      = if_else(is.na(CD8_logFC),      0, CD8_logFC),
    Unstable_logFC = if_else(is.na(Unstable_logFC), 0, Unstable_logFC),
    CD8_padj       = if_else(is.na(CD8_padj),       0, CD8_padj),
    Unstable_padj  = if_else(is.na(Unstable_padj), 0, Unstable_padj)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    CD4_DEG_comp %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj) %>%
      rename(CD4_logFC = avg_log2FC, CD4_padj = p_val_adj),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CD4_logFC = if_else(is.na(CD4_logFC), 0, CD4_logFC),
    CD4_padj  = if_else(is.na(CD4_padj),  0, CD4_padj)
  )

cat("Retained", nrow(merged_sig),
    "genes significant in CD8 or Unstable.\n")

## 7) Direction calls + concordance for CD8 and CD4 vs Unstable
merged_sig_dir <- merged_sig %>%
  mutate(
    direction_CD8 = case_when(
      CD8_logFC > 0  ~ "Up",
      CD8_logFC < 0  ~ "Down",
      TRUE           ~ "NoChange"
    ),
    direction_CD4 = case_when(
      CD4_logFC > 0  ~ "Up",
      CD4_logFC < 0  ~ "Down",
      TRUE           ~ "NoChange"
    ),
    direction_Unstable = case_when(
      Unstable_logFC > 0  ~ "Up",
      Unstable_logFC < 0  ~ "Down",
      TRUE                ~ "NoChange"
    ),
    # CD8 vs Unstable (your original logic)
    concordance_CD8 = case_when(
      direction_CD8 == direction_Unstable & direction_CD8 != "NoChange" ~ "SameDirection",
      direction_CD8 != direction_Unstable &
        direction_CD8 != "NoChange" &
        direction_Unstable != "NoChange" ~ "OppositeDirection",
      TRUE ~ "Neutral"
    ),
    # CD4 vs Unstable (parallel logic)
    concordance_CD4 = case_when(
      direction_CD4 == direction_Unstable & direction_CD4 != "NoChange" ~ "SameDirection",
      direction_CD4 != direction_Unstable &
        direction_CD4 != "NoChange" &
        direction_Unstable != "NoChange" ~ "OppositeDirection",
      TRUE ~ "Neutral"
    )
  )

## 8) Summaries + combined facet plot
direction_long <- bind_rows(
  merged_sig_dir %>%
    count(concordance_CD8) %>%
    mutate(comp = "CD8") %>%
    rename(concordance = concordance_CD8),
  merged_sig_dir %>%
    count(concordance_CD4) %>%
    mutate(comp = "CD4") %>%
    rename(concordance = concordance_CD4)
) %>%
  group_by(comp) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

Concordance <- ggplot(direction_long,
       aes(x = concordance, y = Percent, fill = concordance)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percent, "%")),
            vjust = -0.5, size = txt_mm) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "SameDirection"     = "#1b9e77",
    "OppositeDirection" = "#d95f02",
    "Neutral"           = "grey80"
  )) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ comp, nrow = 1,
    labeller = as_labeller(c(
      CD4 = "CD4 \n Expanded vs. Single",
      CD8 = "CD8 \n Expanded vs. Single"
    ))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "% of genes",
    title = "DEG directionality relative to \n Unstable vs Stable Plaque"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    strip.text   = element_text(size = txt_pt, face = "bold"),
    plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = txt_pt),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) + ylim(c(0,100)) + scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
  SameDirection     = "Same\nDirection",
  OppositeDirection = "Opposite\nDirection",
  Neutral           = "Neutral"
))

svglite("../docs/assets/02-Figure-2/Concordance.svg", width = 5, height = 2.5)
Concordance
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/02-Figure-2/Concordance.svg")
```

## Concordance HM
```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

mat <- merged_sig %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, CD4_logFC, CD8_logFC, Unstable_logFC) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  t()

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "log2FC",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")),

  cluster_rows    = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,

  row_labels = c(
    "CD4_logFC"      = "Plaque CD4+ Expanded vs Single",
    "CD8_logFC"      = "Plaque CD8+ Expanded vs Single",
    "Unstable_logFC" = "Unstable vs Stable"
  )[rownames(mat)],

  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp   = gpar(
    fontsize   = txt_pt,
    fontfamily = "Times"
  ),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "log2FC",
    at    = c(-2, 0, 2),
    labels = c("down", "", "up"),
    direction = "horizontal",

    title_gp  = gpar(
      fontsize   = txt_pt,
      fontfamily = "Times"
    ),
    labels_gp = gpar(
      fontsize   = txt_pt,
      fontfamily = "Times"
    ),

    legend_width  = unit(30, "mm"),
    legend_height = unit(4,  "mm")
  )
)


svglite("../docs/assets/02-Figure-2/Concordance_HM.svg", width = 5, height = 2.5)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
invisible(dev.off())
```

#----Clonal Networks---- {.tabset .tabset-pills}
```{r}
directories <- list.dirs("../data/Human", 
                        recursive = TRUE, 
                        full.names = TRUE)

GEX.files <- directories[grepl("sample_feature_bc_matrix", directories)]

TCR.files <- list.files("../data/Human", 
                        pattern = "filtered_contig_annotations", 
                        recursive = TRUE,
                        full.names = TRUE)

samples <- stringr::str_split(TCR.files, "/", simplify = TRUE)[,4]

TCR.list <- list() #this will be the store for processed seurat objects before merge

for(i in seq_along(TCR.files)) {
  #Adding TCR contig data
  TCR <- read.csv(TCR.files[i], stringsAsFactors = F)
  
  
  ## add sample ID prefic to barcode
TCR$barcode <- paste0(samples[i], "_", TCR$barcode)

  ## subset to remove cells not included post QC
sub <- rownames(subset(Tc_TCR@meta.data, orig.ident == samples[i]))

TCR <- TCR[TCR$barcode %in% sub, ]

## combineTCR
  
  combined.TCR <- combineTCR(list(TCR), 
                             samples = samples[i],
                   removeNA = TRUE, 
                   removeMulti = TRUE)
  
  combined.TCR[[1]]$barcode <- stringr::str_replace(combined.TCR[[1]]$barcode, samples[i], "")
  
combined.TCR[[1]]$barcode <- stringr::str_replace(combined.TCR[[1]]$barcode, "_", "")

    # Add Sample and metadata
rownames(combined.TCR[[1]]) <- combined.TCR[[1]]$barcode

    # Get common row names between the data frames
common_rows <- intersect(rownames(combined.TCR[[1]]), rownames(Tc_TCR@meta.data))
  combined.TCR[[1]]$PID <- Tc_TCR$PID[common_rows]
  combined.TCR[[1]]$celltype <- Tc_TCR$celltype[common_rows]
  combined.TCR[[1]]$Tissue <- Tc_TCR$Tissue[common_rows]
  combined.TCR[[1]]$CD4_8 <- Tc_TCR$CD4_8[common_rows]
  combined.TCR[[1]]$sample <- samples[i]
  TCR.list[[samples[i]]] <- combined.TCR[[1]]

} 

result_df <- bind_rows(TCR.list)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

## ---------- helper to compute network stats per tissue ----------
compute_network_stats <- function(df,
                                  tissue_label,
                                  chain = "TRA",
                                  sequence = "aa",
                                  threshold = 0.75) {
  # only PIDs actually present in this tissue subset
  ids <- unique(df$PID)

  out_list <- vector("list", length(ids))
  names(out_list) <- ids

  for (pid in ids) {
    sub_i <- df[df$PID == pid, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(sub_i) == 0) next

    # be defensive around clonalCluster
    Clusters <- try(
      clonalCluster(
        sub_i,
        chain    = chain,
        sequence = sequence,
        threshold = threshold
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    if (inherits(Clusters, "try-error")) next

    x <- as.data.frame(table(Clusters$TRA_cluster))
    y <- as.data.frame(table(Clusters$cdr3_aa1))

    if (nrow(x) == 0 || nrow(y) == 0) next

    out_list[[pid]] <- data.frame(
      Median.Cluster    = median(x$Freq),
      Mean.Cluster      = mean(x$Freq),
      Median.Clone.Size = median(y$Freq),
      Mean.Clone.Size   = mean(y$Freq),
      Tissue            = tissue_label,
      PID               = pid
    )
  }

  rbindlist(out_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
}

table(result_df$PID, result_df$Tissue)

## subsets 
blood_df    <- subset(result_df, Tissue == "Blood")
stable_df   <- subset(result_df, Tissue == "Stable")
unstable_df <- subset(result_df, Tissue == "Unstable")
plaque_df   <- subset(result_df, Tissue %in% c("Stable", "Unstable")) 
##  run the helper for each 
net_blood    <- compute_network_stats(blood_df,    tissue_label = "Blood")
net_stable   <- compute_network_stats(stable_df,   tissue_label = "Stable")
net_unstable <- compute_network_stats(unstable_df, tissue_label = "Unstable")
net_plaque   <- compute_network_stats(plaque_df,   tissue_label = "Plaque")  # combined stable+unstable

##combine & save
network <- rbindlist(
  list(net_blood, net_plaque, net_stable, net_unstable),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

write.csv(network, file = "../docs/assets/02-Figure-2/network.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#----Morisita Overlap---- {.tabset .tabset-pills}
```{r,}
Tc_TCR$PID_PB <- paste0(Tc_TCR$PID, "_", Tc_TCR$PB)
Clonotypes <- split(Tc_TCR@meta.data, Tc_TCR$PID_PB)

a <- clonalOverlap(Clonotypes, cloneCall = "gene", method = "morisita",  exportTable = T) 
b <- clonalOverlap(Clonotypes, cloneCall = "gene", method = "morisita", chain = "TRA",  exportTable = T) 
c <- clonalOverlap(Clonotypes, cloneCall = "gene", method = "morisita",  chain = "TRB",  exportTable = T) 

a$Chain <- "both"
b$Chain <- "TRA"
c$Chain <- "TRB"

d <- rbind(a,b,c)

d <- d %>%
  mutate(
    Tissue = str_extract(rownames(d), "Blood|Plaque"))

write.csv(d, file = "../docs/assets/02-Figure-2/Overlap.csv")
```
